product.title: Venice of America Fort Lauderdale Cruise

description.text: Cruise Fort Lauderdale’s scenic waterways and see mansions, yachts, and city highlights from the water. This relaxing sightseeing cruise offers live narration and broad views of the Intracoastal Waterway while staying close to central Fort Lauderdale.

highlights: See Fort Lauderdale from the Intracoastal Waterway
Cruise past waterfront mansions and luxury yachts
Enjoy narrated sightseeing with open-air views
Great orientation activity for first-time visitors

start.description: Departs from downtown Fort Lauderdale waterfront. Arrival details are provided on your ticket confirmation.

itineraryItems.title: Boarding and departure
itineraryItems.description: Meet at the designated dock and board your sightseeing vessel.

itineraryItems.title: Intracoastal cruise
itineraryItems.description: Travel through Fort Lauderdale’s canals with views of homes, marinas, and city landmarks.

itineraryItems.title: Return to departure dock
itineraryItems.description: Complete the cruise at the original waterfront meeting point.

additionalInfo: Seating is first-come, first-served unless otherwise noted
Departure times can vary by season

faqs.question: How long is the Fort Lauderdale cruise?
Is this a narrated sightseeing tour?
faqs.answer: Yes, the experience typically includes onboard narration about local highlights and waterfront neighborhoods.

faqs.question: What should I bring?
faqs.answer: Comfortable clothing, sunglasses, and sun protection are recommended for daytime departures.
